$schema_note: Same step schema as ../../data/quests.json (id, label, objective, target{room,anchor}, complete_when) plus: xp, on_enter triggers, and a per-chapter planet biome. Chapters are declarative: the engine only flips flags; worlds spawn what the chapter lists.

chapters.title: Episode 1: Air
chapters.subtitle: The crew of Destiny is running out of breathable air.

steps.label: Arrive on Destiny
steps.objective: You've come through the Stargate onto an Ancient ship. Every door is sealed.

on_enter.text: Everyone stay calm. Eli — those doors aren't opening. Find us some power.

steps.label: Find the power relay
steps.objective: The ship is dark. There is a relay panel on the Gate Room's aft wall — see why it is dead.

steps.label: Find a replacement fuse
steps.objective: The main fuse is blown. Search the salvage crates along the aft wall for one that fits.

on_enter.text: Crates over there came through with us. Check them.

steps.label: Restore power
steps.objective: Seat the small fuse in the relay, then hotwire the protocol lines to route power.

on_enter.text: Small fuse. That is the one. Now to convince the relay to take it.

steps.label: Get to the Control Room
steps.objective: Doors are unlocked. Follow the corridor to the Control Interface Room.

on_enter.text: Eli. Control room. Now — before someone touches something.

steps.label: Access a control terminal
steps.objective: Use the console to check the ship's status.

steps.label: Seal the damaged section
steps.objective: The shuttle dock off the South Access spur is venting to space. Seal it off with the emergency lever.

on_enter.text: Hull breach, port side. Seal that door or we lose the deck.

steps.label: Explore the ship
steps.objective: The breach is sealed. Look around — the crew wing aft of the Control Room has a room with a strange device.

steps.label: Inspect the strange device
steps.objective: A floating ball sits on a pedestal beside a handheld remote. Take them.

on_exit.text: Kino Remote acquired — press TAB (gamepad: Start) for Quest, Character, Inventory, Talents, Ship, Gate and Kino Control.

steps.label: Get down to life support
steps.objective: Rush is on the radio. Find him at the open CO2 scrubber panel in the South Corridor.

on_enter.text: Get down here, Eli. Life support. Bring that remote.

steps.label: Return to the Gate Room
steps.objective: The CO2 scrubbers are dead — the lime bed is exhausted. Head back toward the gate.

on_exit.text: We've dropped out of FTL — and the gate is dialing itself.

steps.label: Send a Kino through the gate
steps.objective: Open the Kino Remote (TAB) → Kino Control → Launch. Fly it through and read the atmosphere.

steps.label: Gear up
steps.objective: Breathable. Grab a shovel and a field backpack from the supply crate.

steps.label: Step through the Stargate
steps.objective: Walk into the event horizon.

steps.label: Dig up lime
steps.objective: Find the dark sand patches and dig with the shovel.

on_enter.text: Darker sand. That's the lime. Five bags should do it.

steps.label: Dial Destiny
steps.objective: Open the Kino Remote → Gate and dial Destiny, then walk through.

steps.label: Give the lime to Brody
steps.objective: Brody can refine it for the scrubbers.

on_exit.text: Give me a minute with this... there. Refined. Get it into the scrubber.

steps.label: Repair the CO2 scrubber
steps.objective: Load the refined lime into the scrubber in life support.

steps.label: Episode complete
steps.objective: The scrubbers are running. We can breathe — for now.

chapters.title: Episode 2: Water
chapters.subtitle: Destiny's reserves are almost gone. The next FTL drop is our only chance.

steps.label: Talk to Rush
steps.objective: Rush has the numbers on the water. Meet him in the Control Room.

steps.label: Return to the Gate Room
steps.objective: Destiny is dropping out of FTL near a frozen world.

steps.label: Scout with a Kino
steps.objective: Kino Remote → Kino Control → Launch. Check the atmosphere before anyone goes through.

steps.label: Step through the Stargate
steps.objective: Bring the shovel — the ice is under the surface.

steps.label: Cut ice
steps.objective: Find the blue-white patches and cut ice blocks.

steps.label: Dial Destiny
steps.objective: Kino Remote → Gate → Destiny.

steps.label: Give the ice to Brody
steps.objective: He'll get it into the reclamation tanks.

steps.label: Restart water reclamation
steps.objective: Load the tanks at the life-support panel.

steps.label: Episode complete
steps.objective: Water is flowing again.

chapters.title: Episode 3: Darkness
chapters.subtitle: Destiny's reserves are failing. The upper deck has been dark since we arrived.

steps.label: Talk to Rush
steps.objective: Rush is in the Control Room with the power numbers.

on_enter.text: Eli. Control room. The reserves are dropping faster than they should.

steps.label: Find two bus fuses
steps.objective: The elevator bus needs two main-bus fuses. Search the salvage crates in the Aft Storage Hall.

on_enter.text: Hydroponics is on the upper deck and the only way up is the elevator. Its bus is dead — no fuses. Storage, aft.

steps.label: Find a heavy-duty fuse
steps.objective: The bus also takes one large fuse. You may already be carrying one; otherwise check the Infirmary.

steps.label: Restore elevator power
steps.objective: Seat the three fuses in the elevator panel in the North Elevator, then hotwire the bus.

on_enter.text: Two bus fuses and one big one. That relay panel by the elevator should take all three.

steps.label: Ride the elevator
steps.objective: Take the elevator to the upper deck.

steps.label: Find Hydroponics
steps.objective: Follow the dark corridor to the Hydroponics bay.

on_enter.text: Upper deck. Nobody has been up here. Watch your step.

steps.label: Restart the grow lights
steps.objective: Use the hydroponics console to bring the bay back online.

on_exit.text: Grow lights are drawing power. Good. Now Destiny can feed us — if the plants cooperate.

steps.label: Episode complete
steps.objective: The upper deck has light again.

chapters.title: Episode 4: Parts
chapters.subtitle: The crew deck is dark. Its power conduit is missing a segment, and Destiny carries no spares.

steps.label: Talk to Rush
steps.objective: Rush has a plan for the crew deck. Find him in the Control Room.

on_enter.text: Eli. The crew quarters on the upper deck — I want them lit before people start sleeping on the gate room floor.

steps.label: Wait for Destiny to drop out of FTL
steps.objective: The next world is dark and cold. Destiny is already slowing.

steps.label: Send a Kino through
steps.objective: The atmosphere is not breathable. Scout it with the Kino first.

on_enter.text: CO2 and nitrogen. Cold enough to crack teeth. But there are ruins — Ancient ruins.

steps.label: Step through the Stargate
steps.objective: You will have the air in your lungs and nothing else. Move fast.

steps.label: Salvage parts from the ruins
steps.objective: Strip conduit alloy from the wreckage near the pillars before your air runs out.

on_enter.text: Your oxygen is the clock, Eli. Four pieces. Then come home.

steps.label: Dial Destiny
steps.objective: Get back to the gate and dial home before the air goes.

steps.label: Bring the parts to Brody
steps.objective: Brody can machine the alloy into a conduit segment.

on_enter.text: Ancient alloy. I can work with this. Give me a minute.

steps.label: Restore the crew deck conduit
steps.objective: Seat the segment in the open conduit junction on the upper-deck corridor, then hotwire the line.

on_enter.text: The junction is on the corridor past the elevator. One segment, then the usual argument with the protocol.

steps.label: Check the crew quarters
steps.objective: The lights should be on. Go and see.

steps.label: Episode complete
steps.objective: The crew has somewhere to sleep.
